corrections.observed_defect: When no session is discovered, the model assumes PDU Session ID 1 and builds an instance from any NAS, owned NGAP, PFCP, or SBI evidence, so a generic UE context alone produces a session instance.
corrections.packet_basis: ngap.pDUSessionID has no value in any frame of either capture, and no PDUSessionResource message, PFCP, or GTP-U traffic is present; both instances report a null observation window and null plane bindings.
corrections.regression_test_to_add: Synthetic input with NGAP InitialUEMessage plus UEContextReleaseCommand only, carrying no pdu_session_resources and no 5GSM identity: expect zero PDU Session instances and no PARTIAL_CAPTURE deviation with empty evidence references.
fixture_families_to_preserve: 5gc-pdu-session examples/expected partial-capture families that carry an observable session id
corrections.expected_behavior_change: Cases whose only session evidence is a generic UE context stop producing an instance; instance counts and the derived PARTIAL_CAPTURE deviations fall accordingly.
corrections.architecture_and_backward_compatibility_: Removes output records that Orchestration currently groups, so downstream candidate counts and diagnostic group counts shift. The output schema itself is unchanged, so this is a semantic contraction rather than a schema break, and it must be authorized as a Domain behavior change.

corrections.observed_defect: The registration-decision absence claim is emitted with a stage identifier that never appears in the instance stage records, so Orchestration has no stage position for it and two window-only absence candidates on the same window resolve to a tie.
corrections.packet_basis: Neither absence candidate has a frame anchor; both cite the identical instance observation window, while the frames inside that window that would carry the counterpart expose ciphered NAS with no decodable message-type octet.
corrections.regression_test_to_add: Synthetic registration input where no terminal NAS message is decodable: expect the emitted absence claim to publish a stage position that exists in its own stage records, or to be reported as an evidence limitation rather than as a selectable candidate competing at the earliest position.
fixture_families_to_preserve: registration examples/expected terminal-decision families with observable accept and reject
corrections.expected_behavior_change: Ambiguous selection on window-only absence pairs becomes either a determinate earliest boundary or an explicit insufficient-comparable-evidence result.
corrections.architecture_and_backward_compatibility_: Any ordering remedy must stay inside the provenance contract. Severity-based selection or invented ordering between incomparable windows is prohibited, and 5gc-failure-boundary ordering must not be changed to compensate for a Domain provenance gap.

corrections.observed_defect: An intermediate authentication outcome that the same capture shows being recovered is still classified as an abnormal-boundary candidate, because the deviation vocabulary has no class for a recovered local outcome.
corrections.packet_basis: Frame 41 exposes mm.message_type 0x59 with 5GMM cause 21 as a plain message, and frames 42-47 expose the re-challenge, a plain authentication response, a security mode command, and N2 context establishment.
corrections.regression_test_to_add: Synthetic resynchronization sequence: authentication request, authentication failure with cause 21, a second authentication request, authentication response, and security mode command; expect the unsuccessful-outcome deviation to remain and the boundary candidate to be withheld.
fixture_families_to_preserve: registration examples/expected unsuccessful-outcome families without recovery
corrections.expected_behavior_change: Recovered intermediate outcomes stop entering candidate selection while remaining visible as procedure deviations.
corrections.architecture_and_backward_compatibility_: Narrowing eligible deviation types can turn ambiguous groups into no-boundary results, which must never be reported as procedure success; the accepted baseline conclusion for this case stays unchanged.

corrections.observed_defect: A lower-layer UNKNOWN support status caused by a ciphered NAS envelope is republished as an unknown or reserved protocol value, so one physical observation is reported under two deviation types.
corrections.packet_basis: Every affected frame exposes nas-5gs.security_header_type 2 or 4 with no decodable nas-5gs.mm.message_type octet, so no message-type byte is present to be unknown or reserved.
corrections.regression_test_to_add: Synthetic NAS events with support_status UNKNOWN, security.ciphered true, and inner_message_available false: expect exactly one protected-inner-message-unavailable deviation per envelope and no unknown-or-reserved protocol-value deviation.
fixture_families_to_preserve: registration examples/expected unsupported-message families with a genuinely dissected message-type byte
corrections.expected_behavior_change: Deviation counts per protected frame halve; the protected-envelope limitation record remains the single carrier of that evidence.
corrections.architecture_and_backward_compatibility_: Expected-output fixtures that currently list both deviation types must be refreshed, and the deviation type enum stays unchanged so no schema break occurs. Protocol and Correlation runtimes are not involved.

scope_note: Ranking expresses dependency order and evidentiary certainty over the public corpus categories, not a severity claim. No correction is implemented by this area.
